summary: In this tutorial, you learn how to create and manage notes in Microsoft PowerPoint for both audience support and presenter reference. Notes can be added to each slide to provide additional information or references. To add notes, click on the Notes tab, and a text box appears below the slide where you can type your notes. These notes can be edited and formatted as needed. You can also customize the notes master to set a standard format for all notes across the presentation. To do this, go to the View menu, select Notes Master, and choose a template to format the notes. Additionally, you can add logos and shapes to the notes by selecting the Drawing toolbar, choosing a shape, and positioning it on the notes text box. This tutorial covers various aspects of managing and customizing notes within a PowerPoint presentation, including formatting, adding elements, and ensuring consistency across slides.
